title: Syntax, Meaning, Statements amadi Expressions
learningObjectives: Syntax niyam kari maru oibano haibadu tak-u.
JavaScript-ta bracket amadi symbol-gi error khang-u.
Syntax amadi logic error-gi marakta farak tak-u.
Statement asi complete instruction-ni haibadu khang-u.
Expression asi Value pibiba code-gi part-ni haibadu khang-u.
2 + 3 amadi price * quantity-gi value calculate tou-u.
Declaration, assignment amadi function call khang-u.
Syntax amadi logic separate check tou-u.
Error-gi type khangduna correction suggest tou-u.
Price amadi quantity-gi example-da total calculate tou-u.
Variables, operators, conditions, loops amadi functions sikhaba-gi foundation oina sijinnou.

understand.concept: Programming language-da code semjaba niyam lei. Masi Syntax kou-i. Semantics-na valid code-gi meaning amadi action tak-i. Statement asi complete instruction-ni. Expression asi evaluate touba matamda Value pibiba code-gi part-ni.
understand.whyItMatters: Syntax-na code semjaba rule tak-i; Semantics-na meaning tak-i; Statement-na instruction tak-i; Expression-na Value pib-i.
understand.history: এই পাঠে বিভিন্ন ভাষার সাধারণ নিয়ম শেখানো হয়।
understand.analogy: Mising language-gi grammar-na Syntax-gumna, sentence-gi meaning-na Semantics-gumna.
understand.analogyLimit: Programming language-na fixed rule follow tou-i. Masi example khaktani.

explain.narrative: Syntax-na code karamna semjagani haibadu tak-i. JavaScript-ta let, const, operator amadi bracket-gi rule lei. Symbol nattraga bracket leitrabadi Syntax Error thok-i. Syntax correct oirabasu wrong operation-na Logic Error thok-i. const total = 2 + 3; asi declaration Statement-ni, 2 + 3 asi Expression-ni, result 5-ni.

examples.explanation: 2 + 3-gi result 5-ni. Complete declaration asi Statement amadi calculation asi Expression-ni.
2 + 3-gi result 5-ni. Complete declaration asi Statement amadi calculation asi Expression-ni.

practise.guidedTask: price 120 amadi quantity 2 example-ta Statement amadi Expression mark tou, total 240 calculate tou.
practise.independentTask: Price, quantity amadi total show touba JavaScript example sem-u. Syntax amadi Logic mistake ama ama ha-u.
hints: Code-na intended calculation tou-i haibadu check tou.

questions.prompt: Syntax correct oirabasu wrong operation sijinnabadi?
